scope: Structured compose plan/data/parser/planning diagnostics. No executor, Controller, Bridge, Player, service or model weight modifications by this subtask.

implementation.ArdyControlPlan: Pure System serializable class with public frozen fields, finite bounds/enums/dependencies validation, Copy(), invariant summary.
implementation.DialogueMotionIntent: Existing four-argument constructor retained; five-argument constructor copies nullable ControlPlan. compose description is empty.
implementation.routing: Independent basic gestures keep priority. Explicit directional holds/local curves use compose. Open motion uses generate.
implementation.provenance: compose is geometric/controlled local motion, not ARDY native quality improvement.
implementation.heldPose: current means measured current pose; cannot recover historical idle pose. Hold is executor-bounded at 30 seconds, not indefinite text state.
implementation.numericParsing: InvariantCulture float/int parsing; nonfinite, invalid enums, wrong-route attributes, unknown attributes, duplicate attributes and missing wrist-arm targets rejected.

productionCpuValidation.environment: Actual production ArdyControlPlan/DialogueMotionProtocol/RoleOutputChannels/SpeechText compiled with Unity Roslyn+Mono C#9; exact pure methods extracted from Editor regression, no stubs.

realPlanning.busyGuard: Only sequential calls when all existing /slots is_processing false; no service startup/stop or ARDY calls.
observedComposeTargets: Both forward, both wrists/up/10 degrees/2 cycles/3.2 seconds/hold
Idle follow-up restores forward goals and straight bends, rather than using historical current
Both forward with zero elbow bends and no local motion/hold

additionalCoverage: Real same-plan dedup vs different numeric plan dispatch
Basic-only capability suppresses compose advertisement and dispatch
Actual holding facts and bounded hold text delivered in request context
Compose numeric fields excluded from real ChatSample TTS queue
Silent pure compose callback dispatches without empty-LLM-response failure

notes: Initial and second free generate descriptions were 243/251 characters and were rejected by real parser; not truncated or counted as executable passes.
A focused previous-contract comparison showed a 202-character valid free description. Added a general one-short-sentence/25-word plus 240-character output constraint.

Attempt r3 used the old naive C# constant reader, which truncated a string at an internal ASCII semicolon; retained but excluded as exact-contract evidence. Reader now parses entire literal concatenations; final r4 contract hash verified against the compiled C# constant.

limits: These development requests test structured intent selection and real parser acceptance, not unseen-action generalization.
No physical wrist isolation, transition smoothness, pose matching, interruption or hold timeout was tested by this subtask; executor and real Unity validation belong to root/shared agent.
Actual controlled motion is not evidence that the ARDY generator learned independent wrist control.
